observation: Fresh main still treats the writer-owned rcl field as any object or null. decide() actually emits only two envelope families: an error envelope with error/message, or a runtime-result envelope with stateRoot/rule/actor/authority/witnesses/historyLength. Empty or structurally impossible objects can therefore be persisted even though the current writer never produces them.
changes: Validate non-null rcl payloads as either the existing error envelope or the existing runtime-result envelope, preserving currently unconstrained nested runtime values.
Publish the same envelope union in the v0.1 schema without defining new RCL result semantics or a trust architecture.
